observationsNotFindings: The strongest thing in this specification is that its two scope exclusions are grounded rather than asserted. Refusing analyze and consented probes as the G05 workload reproduces D-006's own clause 4, which places those surfaces DELIBERATELY outside D-006 pending real workloads and product sign-off; and refusing G03/G04 help/version/doctor-read-only as the subtracted baseline is paired with a positive construction - one thin projection P measured with and without the component - so the exclusion is not merely a prohibition but has a stated replacement. The negative-delta rule closes the failure mode a paired difference is most exposed to.

The only substantive numeral in the file is N=21, and it is sourced: the parent attributes it to D-102 turn-2 subject 7780190e, and four of the parent's five harness elements carry it. A reviewer sweeping for invented constants should expect that figure and should not read it as a cap.
